_comment: A template to merge into deployment.json (the host's, not a source's): a pack declares no schedules, grants or credentials. Merge, never replace: keep the data_pool keys you already have. No credential values here. Writing needs a pool grant: in the data-pool service add the librarian Soot to its writers (or its write role) and grant it write on each public pool it keeps; the binding file never holds a secret in this repository. With a per-Soot DATA_POOL credential instead of the shared data_pool block, bind the librarian's own DATA_POOL to an environment variable (for example LIBRARIAN_DATA_POOL, set outside this file) with the operations data-pool_pools, data-pool_query, data-pool_status and data-pool_write. Marking a pool public is a pool manager's action (data-pool_manage pool_update public:true), never the librarian's. Never mark the data_pool.feedback pool public.

schedules.name: Thủ thư xem lại các câu hỏi chưa có đáp án
schedules.text: Daily sweep: read the librarian skill. List your open knowledge-gap tasks (task list, query "knowledge-gap", status todo, doing or blocked). For each, check whether a pool document now answers it and close it, or research it and write the fact. Ask a person only when sources are missing or disagree. End with one line: gaps closed, gaps still open.

schedules.name: Thủ thư kiểm tra lại nguồn tin cậy
schedules.text: Weekly refresh: read the librarian-refresh skill and re-check the trusted sources kept in your memory against the pool documents they feed. Update only what changed, with the revision you read. Report what changed.
